items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: that was the Walden Brothers and Booker Washington

ctx.x: Now, yeah, now, the Reno Club was two blocks from the Bar-le-Duc, where we were. I'll put it the other way. We were two blocks from the Reno Club, and one block, across the street and on the corner was the Green Leaf, where Bird was working with another alto player and, I think, drums and piano.
And up the street past us for about a block and a half was the Spinning Wheel, (inaudible), that was the Walden Brothers and Booker Washington, and I can't remember --
